title: Paired fin-ray uncertainty and load-shape assay

predicate.expression: For both uniform load q and same-total tip force q*L: abs(tip)/L <= 0.1 and max(abs(slope)) <= 0.2 rad

candidates.tradeoff: Reference declared geometry; not an observed specimen
Shortening may lose lifting area; flight consequence unmodeled
Stiffness change has unknown mass, material and developmental cost

weather.dependence: Perfect negative rank correlation, declared stress scenario; not fitted weather data

geometry.dependence: Shared geometry latent, positive rank correlation; not measured covariance

design_material.dependence: One material draw shared across all candidates, not independent material evidence

aerodynamics.dependence: Independent latent by design; no fitted aerodynamic polar

bluegill_context_material.dependence: Separate source context; never transferred to candidate design material

context_only.locator: Alben, Madden & Lauder (2007), Section 3.4 after Eq.3.19
context_only.source_status: Approximate composite-modulus range and average area moment, not a per-ray dataset
context_only.load_status: assumed illustration, not a measured load from the source
context_only.transfer: refused: species, size, fluid regime, bilaminar mechanics and boundary/actuation differ
context_only.heldout_validation: unknown: published Fig.7 slope1.98N/m lacks a matched per-ray geometry/EI/actuation tuple for this single-beam surrogate

analysis.robustness_denominator: 64 independently drawn latent vectors per candidate; both paired load shapes must pass; meshes and load shapes are not independent trials
analysis.interval: Wilson95 binomial interval conditional on this declared iid latent sampling distribution, not biological success or empirical uncertainty
analysis.sensitivity: Paired plus/minus1percent parameter interventions, all other physical inputs fixed; local elasticity, not causal biology or independent-distribution importance
analysis.discrepancy: Separate coarse/fine FEM profile difference, analytic residual and uniform/tip load-shape difference
analysis.invalid_cases: Preserve outputs as formal linear-model extrapolations; mask them from claims of physically valid shape
analysis.candidate_decision: Retain all three candidates; report paired robustness changes and unknown flight/material costs rather than selecting a biological winner
analysis.time_accuracy: not applicable: static problem; variation video indexes ensemble members, not physical time

region_membership: UI annotation only; no calibrated spatial mapping to a real fish
